source: Visible browser assertions through accessibility snapshot

checks.name: All 12 table modes and 11 schema form configurations mount
Local filtering, tri-state sort, page-size and jump use the same result set
Across-page selection survives paging, respects disabled rows and supports all filtered
Page selection clears on navigation and a single-selection table uses radio
Tree rows search descendants with ancestor context and expand independently
Grouped rows collapse without changing underlying records
Nested headers and adjacent merged values have real spans; sums use filtered rows
Explicit row/column spans skip covered cells
Column visibility retains at least one and reordering updates the public state
Fixed columns compute sticky offsets and keyboard resizing persists widths
Row ordering supports keyboard and is disabled while sorting
Inline edit validates before commit and Escape cancels draft
Switching page protects an uncommitted cell draft
Table edit dialog uses the shared schema validator and preserves zero
Deletion requires confirmation, can cancel, and retains unrelated rows
Virtual scrolling renders a bounded number of rows out of 10000 and changes window
CSV respects visible columns and neutralizes spreadsheet formulas
Remote queries carry request IDs; stale responses cannot replace newer results
Remote failure preserves query and retries through the loader
Readonly and forbidden states cannot mutate table data
Arbitrary schema uses supplied fields and does not inherit course fields
Sync rules include required, email, numeric range, regex and cross-field dates
Dependent options clear stale selection, conditional fields are excluded from values
Repeaters retain data while adding, reordering and removing; enforce minimum
Steps validate the current section before navigation and retain previous values
Error summary locates a field in another tab
Async validator aborts stale values; earlier results cannot overwrite new input
Async validator failure is visible, and cancel during validation does not submit
Submitting is locked, prevents duplicate submits, and a failed handler retains all values
Event-mode submit remains pending until its matching acknowledgement
Reset uses a successful submission as baseline and protects unsaved UI changes
Readonly/disabled/forbidden forms do not submit and disabled fields are excluded
Unmount cancels submission callbacks and prevents late status changes
All 23 configurations fit a 320px container without outer overflow
Dependent numeric edits keep focus, caret and computed values during typing
Generic numeric fields do not inherit course-hour units
Remote edit stays pending until mutation acknowledgement and keeps server field errors
All additional chart, permission-tree and richtext examples mount
Chart zoom, drilldown and return use real child data
Combo chart series visibility, brush and data table stay synchronized
Permission trees support strict checks and disabled-ancestor inheritance
Richtext sanitizes scripts, event attributes, embeds and unsafe links
Richtext formatting works and schema rules count plain text rather than HTML tags
Form loader ignores old acknowledgements, preserves draft on failure and retries
Runtime readonly state hides form submit and disables table editing
Repeated file fields preserve File references through row reordering
Two fixed columns use measured offsets at wide container sizes
Tree pagination pages root groups and keeps children with their parent
Remote cell save waits for mutator success and reloads confirmed server values
Additional interactive charts and richtext fit a 320px host
Chinese composition does not commit intermediate values or trigger a submission
Export selected includes cross-page selections outside the current filter
Multiple bar series occupy separate positions without overlap
